extraction.agency_name: Office of the Clerk of Circuit Court Talbot County

findings.title: Controls over cash receipts and employee access to related automated records were not sufficient, and certain reconciliations were not being completed.
findings.description: The Office had insufficient controls over cash receipts and UCS user access, and critical reconciliations between the UCS and State accounting records were not completed as required by policy. The Office generated output reports of non-cash credits and void transactions that were reviewed by an employee with system capabilities to process them.

dollar_amounts.context: non-cash credits processed during fiscal year 2013
receipt voids processed during fiscal year 2013

findings.recommendation: We recommend that the Office ensure that output reports of non-cash credits and void transactions recorded in the UCS are reviewed by an employee who is not assigned system capabilities to process these transactions, verified to supporting documentation, and that this review is documented; ensure that system user access is reviewed in accordance with Judiciary policy requirements; and reconcile collection data recorded in the UCS to the State's accounting records as required.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The Judiciary's response to the findings and recommendations is included as an appendix to this report.
extraction.extraction_notes: Report date derived from header 'August 2014' as no specific transmittal letter date was provided. Agency agreement status not explicitly stated in text.
